scope: EventBus handler subprocess environment and result protocol unit checks
checks: all worker-specific database URLs and worker credentials are removed from handler subprocess environments
shared runtime and non-worker environment entries are preserved for current handlers
handler requests are sent through stdin and not placed in command-line arguments
allowlisted handler runner supports legacy and event-id signatures and returns a stable JSON result
handler failures remain bounded error results
timeouts kill and reap the handler subprocess
invalid requests and subprocess exit failures do not expose captured worker secrets
